message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 77.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in networks and testing. I want to become a Information Technology Manager. My family can afford at most about USD 1200 per year. I live in Mumbai. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India.
explanation:
This program is highly recommended because it meets your strong preference for staying in Mumbai while focusing on QA Testing. The annual tuition of $850 USD fits well within your family's budget constraint of $1200. While the curriculum focuses specifically on 'qa_testing,' which aligns with your interest, the main trade-off is that this program does not explicitly cover networking or IT management skills needed for a manager role.

This option remains in Mumbai and provides a blend of 'qa_testing' and 'software_engineering,' which is beneficial for both your interests and career goal. At an annual tuition cost of $500 USD, it is the most budget-friendly choice among the Mumbai options. The trade-off here is that its median starting salary ($6458 USD) is among the lower figures in this shortlist.

With a low tuition cost of $800 USD, it is highly budget-friendly. The main trade-off is the location; while excellent for career goals, it requires you to consider Coimbatore instead of staying near Mumbai.

This program offers a strong focus on 'qa_testing' and is conveniently located in Mumbai, satisfying your location preference. The tuition fee of $1200 USD perfectly matches the upper limit of your budget. The trade-off compared to other options is that its placement rate (72%) is slightly lower than some alternatives.
